story_en: The baker works at the local shop. Every morning, he sells fresh bread, sweet apples, and healthy carrots. A friendly doctor comes to buy some vegetables for lunch. The farmer brings fresh tomatoes and oranges from the village. Everyone loves shopping in this peaceful town.
story_tr: Fırıncı yerel dükkanda çalışır. Her sabah taze ekmek, tatlı elmalar ve sağlıklı havuçlar satar. Dost canlısı bir doktor öğle yemeği için biraz sebze almaya gelir. Çiftçi köyden taze domatesler ve portakallar getirir. Herkes bu sakin kasabada alışveriş yapmayı sever.

words.example_en: The baker makes fresh bread every morning.
words.example_tr: Fırıncı her sabah taze ekmek yapar.

words.example_en: The doctor helps sick people at the hospital.
words.example_tr: Doktor hastanede hasta insanlara yardım eder.

words.example_en: The farmer grows vegetables in the field.
She eats a red apple for a snack.
words.example_tr: Atıştırmalık olarak kırmızı bir elma yiyor.

words.example_en: Fresh orange juice is very healthy.
Rabbits like to eat crunchy carrots.
I need red tomatoes for the salad.
words.example_tr: Salata için kırmızı domateslere ihtiyacım var.

words.example_en: We buy warm bread from the bakery.
